text.tspan: Change in CO₂ emissions and GDP
Consumption-based emissions are national emissions that have been adjusted for trade. This measures fossil
fuel and industry emissions. Land-use change emissions are not included.

tspan.tspan: Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026); Global Carbon Budget (2025)
GDP is measured in international-$ at 2021 prices to account for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
